data.title: Tree felling permit refused
data.summary: The Bezirksamt Musterbek (Hamburg district office) refused your application of 16 March 2026 to fell a copper beech at Eppendorfer Stieg 7. The letter is dated 30 April 2026.
data.explanation: Your request to fell the beech tree was rejected. The authority says the tree is protected under the tree protection ordinance (Baumschutzverordnung), is healthy and stable, and that shading of your balcony is not an unreasonable burden. You may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at the office; the app shows until when. Without an objection the decision becomes final. Do not fell the tree without a permit. Consider professional advice if you want to challenge the decision.
